# Tesseract English model

`eng.traineddata.gz` is `eng.traineddata` from github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast (main branch),
retrieved October 2026, gzipped (gzip -9) because Tesseract.js loads `<lang>.traineddata.gz`.

- SHA-256 of the original (uncompressed) file: `7d4322bd2a7749724879683fc3912cb542f19906c83bcc1a52132556427170b2`
- 4,113,088 bytes uncompressed

  `licenses/Tesseract-Apache-2.0.txt`)
